video_title: Biggest Early NBA Overreactions - Time For Panic Or Patience?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst and Tim MacMahon debate Cooper Flagg's defensive potential
quotes.excerpt: Cooper Flagg is better at defense than LeBron was at the same age. I don't even think it's debatable.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I want to 100% clarify what I said about Cooper Flagg. In my view, Cooper Flagg is better at defense than LeBron James was at the same age. I don't even think it's debatable. There were defensive plays that LeBron made at that age, he certainly would get into passing lanes, he certainly would block shots, he was a defensive playmaker, but Cooper is better defensively, empirically. I don't think that's debatable.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Honestly, that's the one aspect of Cooper Flagg's game that is still very much a work in progress.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: If you looked at Cooper's form and looked at LeBron's form at 19, that's why I say technique. Obviously, LeBron entered the league as a generational scorer who could fall out of bed and not even get his ankles taped.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Dusty May's assessment of Cooper Flagg's decision-making
quotes.excerpt: Dusty May estimated that Cooper Flagg with the ball in his hands has made about 800 reads.
quotes.quote: I was talking to Dusty May postgame last night. He estimated that Cooper Flagg with the ball in his hands has made about 800 reads between the preseason and the four games he's played in the regular season. He said he has made one wrong read. The guy is already, there's been some turnovers, I mean it's always perfect execution, but about one out of 800 incorrect reads.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: David Blatt's coaching decision in the 2015 playoffs
quotes.excerpt: David Blatt almost calls a timeout he doesn't have, which would have lost the Cavs the game.
quotes.quote: In Game 4, the Cavs are in serious trouble. It's the game where David Blatt almost calls a timeout he doesn't have, which would have lost the Cavs the game, put them down 3-1. Tyronn Lue almost tackles Blatt. Scott Foster, I can't prove what Scott Foster saw and knew, but I suspect Scott Foster gave him a pass. LeBron ends up hitting a buzzer-beater to win the game.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Pelton's move to the Connecticut Sun front office
quotes.excerpt: We very sadly had to say goodbye to our longtime colleague Kevin Pelton.
quotes.quote: We very sadly had to say goodbye to our longtime colleague Kevin Pelton, who has gone to work for the Connecticut Sun front office. I am fairly certain that Travis Scott's business entity bought up all of the defunct WNBA teams and that he owns the copyright, trademark, whatever, and that the Houston Comets were negotiating trying to get it. Kevin Pelton is now working in the front office of a WNBA team.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Connelly on Karl-Anthony Towns' knee injury
quotes.excerpt: Tim Connelly, the general manager, came out on Wednesday and said the MRI that we got.
quotes.quote: Tim Connelly, the general manager, came out on Wednesday and said the MRI that we got, because people were saying, why did he, because he had the knee injury last season and then he obviously went through the whole summer and started the year and they're like, why didn't he, why is the surgery happening now? Number one, he tweaked the knee in Miami on opening night. Number two, when they did the MRI on Tuesday, they very clearly saw something that they hadn't seen before. Otherwise, they wouldn't have had him in surgery on Thursday.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards' performance against Peyton Watson
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Edwards flat out toasted Peyton Watson a number of times.
quotes.quote: The Cavs fans were very excited with the way Peyton Watson played defensively in that game, and Peyton Watson had another good game by the way on Wednesday night, the Cavs beat the Wizards and he had a good game, 22 points in that game. But I'm going to tell you, Anthony Edwards flat out toasted Peyton Watson a number of times, and that's not a criticism of Peyton Watson. Like, he wanted anything he could do about it because Anthony Edwards looked so good.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Warriors' defensive strategy against Rudy Gobert
quotes.excerpt: The Warriors came back and developed their own sort of curveball game plan to pull Rudy Gobert.
quotes.quote: The Warriors came back, Anthony Slater wrote about this extensively on ESPN.com, the Warriors came back and developed their own sort of curveball game plan to pull Rudy Gobert out of the way, and Steph got 16 shots in the first half. They were totally, and I assume there's going to be a cat and mouse game. We're beginning to see it. You can already see how the teams have totally changed the way they're defending Walker Kessler after he got all those dunks in those first two, three games.

quotes.speaker: Ben Golliver
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of the Miles Bridges trade on the Hornets
quotes.excerpt: All the focus on LaMelo, he has a strong start in Minnesota, but they made another trade.
quotes.quote: All the focus on LaMelo, he has a strong start in Minnesota, but they made another trade with the Bridges trade to Phoenix, and that is looking amazing for them. They're getting great production from Grayson Allen. Bridges has been kind of off to I would say a tough start in Phoenix, plus they've got draft picks coming for that deal. And so as they look big picture, the idea this summer was, let's take a half step back by trading LaMelo because we don't think we can really contend with this group.

quotes.speaker: Ben Golliver
quotes.summary_phrase: The challenges of the Sacramento Kings' roster construction
quotes.excerpt: The central tension for them is you have a rookie point guard in Darius Garland.
quotes.quote: The central tension for them is you have a rookie point guard in Darius Garland who is sort of getting the greenest light you could possibly imagine. It's almost like they want him to be like Damian Lillard was back when I was covering him in Portland, where it's just completely empowered, do what you can do. Of course, Lillard came in with four years of college experience and was pretty much ready to go in the rookie of the year conversation. Garland, not so much. And I think you've got some veterans there in Sacramento who are looking around saying, wait a minute, what is happening? What are we doing?

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Milwaukee Bucks' starting lineup performance
quotes.excerpt: Turner, Kuzma, Hero, Rollins, Hakeem are plus 33 in 53 minutes.
quotes.quote: Turner, Kuzma, Hero, Rollins, Hakeem are plus 33 in 53 minutes. Gary Trent Jr. played seven minutes, his first playing time of the season. The worst lineup in the league, any guesses?
